lines.en: label beachvacation12:
scene sunbathing1
: Hello, ladies.
lines.zh: : 你们好啊，女士们。

lines.en: : You sound kinda creepy when ya just walk up to a group of half-naked girls and say “Hey, ladies,” Sensei.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你走到一群半裸的女生面前就说「嗨，女士们」，听起来还真够变态的。

lines.en: : Not being creepy isn’t really a strong suit of mine.
lines.zh: : 「不变态」本来就不是我的强项。

lines.en: : Aww, come on. You’re not that bad.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别这样。你也没那么糟。

lines.en: I stumble upon Chika, Tsuneyo, and Miku laying out on a blanket once the afternoon rolls around.
lines.zh: 下午过半的时候，我撞见Chika、Tsuneyo和Miku摊在一条毯子上。

lines.en: And, in case you were wondering, no. Maya didn’t actually die during the watermelon incident.
lines.zh: 另外，如果你还在担心的话——Maya并没有在西瓜事件里真的死掉。

lines.en: Thankfully, Karin was able to hold back and only used a fraction of her true power.
lines.zh: 多亏花梨收住了力，只用了她真实力量的一小部分。

lines.en: So Maya got off without any internal bleeding whatsoever.
lines.zh: 所以Maya一点内伤都没有就挺过来了。

lines.en: What a joyous occasion.
lines.zh: 真是个可喜可贺的日子。

lines.en: : You.
: Hi, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 嗨，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: scene sunbathing2
: Ah-
scene sunbathing1
: Wait, no. Stop that.
lines.zh: : 等等，不对。别来这套。

lines.en: : I am mad at you.
lines.zh: : 我在生你的气。

lines.en: : Why? I haven’t even really seen you since yesterday and-
lines.zh: : 为什么？我昨天之后就没怎么见过你，而且——

lines.en: : Oh.
: Yeah, I probably know what this is about.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我大概知道是因为什么了。

lines.en: scene sunbathing3
: Sneaky move havin’ us girls do yer’ dirty work for ya. Karin almost died.
lines.zh: : 让我们这些女生替你干脏活，这招可真阴。花梨差点就没命了。

lines.en: : Is that why she was passed out in her breakfast when I made it to the beach this morning?
lines.zh: : 所以今早我到海滩的时候，她才趴在自己的早餐上昏过去？

lines.en: : Yup! Ruined a perfectly good dish and Ayane had to go buy her another one.
lines.zh: : 对！好好的一盘菜就这么毁了，Ayane还跑去给她重新买了一份。

lines.en: : Oh. Well then no one lost except for Ayane’s dad. This seems fine to me.
lines.zh: : 哦。那除了Ayane她爸，谁也没损失。我觉得这挺好的。

lines.en: scene sunbathing4
: Wrong. I lost.
lines.zh: : 不对。我有损失。

lines.en: : I learned things today that I was not ready to learn.
lines.zh: : 我今天知道了些我还没准备好要知道的东西。

lines.en: : To be fair, these are things you probably should have learned about a while ago.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，那些东西你大概早就该知道了。

lines.en: : Fuck you.
lines.zh: : 操你的。

lines.en: : Yeah...Think I’m gonna go out on a limb and side with Tsuneyo here, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我这次要破例站Tsuneyo这边，Sensei。

lines.en: : It’s probably for the best if you just...don’t talk about masturbation or sex or anything like that with her.
lines.zh: : 你们最好还是……别跟她聊自慰或者性行为什么的。

lines.en: : I don’t think she’s prepared for that kinda stuff yet.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她还没准备好接受那种东西。

lines.en: scene sunbathing5
: Yeah. Not everyone here’s as mature as Chika and me, Sensei. Some people just take a little longer to develop. Like noodle-girl!
lines.zh: : 对啊。这儿不是每个人都像Chika和我这么成熟，Sensei。有些人发育得就是慢一点。比如那个面条妹！

lines.en: : Wow, Miku. I had no idea you were ready to talk about stuff like that.
lines.zh: : 哇，Miku。我没想到你已经准备好聊那种事了。

lines.en: : Whaddya mean? I’m ready to talk about anythin’ ya throw at me. Just name it.
lines.zh: : 啥意思？不管你抛出什么我都聊。尽管说。

lines.en: : Any thoughts on reverse cowgirl?
lines.zh: : 对反向女牛仔有什么看法吗？

lines.en: scene sunbathing6
: Sensei! What do you think you’re asking her?!
lines.zh: : Sensei！你以为自己在问什么？！

lines.en: jump cowboyx
label cowboyx:
: Reverse what? What’s that mean?
lines.zh: : 反向什么？那是什么意思？

lines.en: : See?! She has no idea!
lines.zh: : 看吧？！她根本不知道！

lines.en: : What do cowboys have to do with...the M word.
lines.zh: : 牛仔跟……那个 M 开头的词有什么关系？

lines.en: : It’s cowgirls. And they have more to do with the S word than the M word.
lines.zh: : 是女牛仔。而且它们跟 S 开头的词关系更大，不是 M 开头的。

lines.en: scene sunbathing7
: That word is even worse.
lines.zh: : 那个词更糟。

lines.en: : Wait, hold the phone. I still have no idea what’s goin’ on. I’ve never heard of the backwards cowboy either.
lines.zh: : 等等，先别挂电话。我还是完全没搞懂。我也从没听说过「倒过来的牛仔」。

lines.en: : You completely changed the name of the position. Don’t slander reverse cowgirl like that.
lines.zh: : 你把这体位的名字全改了。别这样污蔑反向女牛仔。

lines.en: : Okay! That’s it! Changing the subject!
lines.zh: : 好！够了！换话题！

lines.en: : Sensei, how was your night? Did you do anything fun?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你昨晚怎么样？有做什么好玩的事吗？

lines.en: scene sunbathing8
: Well, I watched the girls play a weird game with Tsuneyo. And then I hung out with Sana for a bit.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我和Tsuneyo一起看了女生们玩一个奇怪的游戏。然后跟Sana待了一会儿。

lines.en: scene sunbathing9
: Oh. I remember that.
lines.zh: : 哦。我想起来了。

lines.en: : I don’t think I like beer very much.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我不太喜欢啤酒。

lines.en: scene sunbathing10
: You got her drunk?
lines.zh: : 你把她灌醉了？

lines.en: : She got herself drunk. I just...didn’t stop her.
lines.zh: : 是她自己喝醉的。我只是……没拦着她。

lines.en: : You didn’t do anything...weird to her, did you?
lines.zh: : 你没对她做什么……奇怪的事吧？

lines.en: : I woke up in the middle of the night and was tucked into a futon.
lines.zh: : 我半夜醒过来，发现自己被塞进了被褥里。

lines.en: : This means he must have done something weird to me.
lines.zh: : 这说明他一定对我做了什么奇怪的事。

lines.en: : I might be sheltered, but I’m capable of putting myself to bed, thank you very much.
lines.zh: : 我也许是被保护得太好，但我自己还是能爬上床睡觉的，多谢关心。

lines.en: : That was probably one of the girls. I sort of just pushed you off of me when I left the room last night.
lines.zh: : 那应该是某个女生干的。我昨晚离开房间的时候，差不多就是把你从我身上推开而已。

lines.en: : Oh. That’s okay then.
lines.zh: : 哦。那就没事了。

lines.en: : But we still need to find out who did weird things to me.
lines.zh: : 不过我们还是得找出是谁对我做了奇怪的事。

lines.en: scene sunbathing11
: Oh! That was me.
lines.zh: : 哦！是我。

lines.en: : You weren’t really sleepin’ in the best spot so I kinda just dragged ya into bed and put the blanket around you.
lines.zh: : 你睡的位置实在不怎么样，我就把你拖到了床上，还给你盖好了毯子。

lines.en: : Crazy, too. You must have drank a lot ‘cause ya didn’t wake up when I accidentally touched ‘yer boob.
lines.zh: : 还有件离谱的事。你肯定喝了不少，因为我不小心碰到你的胸，你都没醒。

lines.en: : So you did do weird things to me.
lines.zh: : 所以你确实对我做了奇怪的事。

lines.en: : Mmm...kinda! But it was on accident.
lines.zh: : 嗯……算是吧！可那是不小心的。

lines.en: scene sunbathing12
: That’s what they all say...
lines.zh: : 他们都是这么说的……

lines.en: : So, what’s this about you and Sana?
lines.zh: : 那你和Sana是怎么回事？

lines.en: : I know that Rin and some of the others were going to be playing a game, so I get that part. But wasn’t Sana playing with them?
lines.zh: : 我知道Rin和其他几个人要玩游戏，这部分我懂。可Sana不是也跟她们一起玩吗？

lines.en: : When would you two have even met up?
lines.zh: : 你们俩到底什么时候碰上的？

lines.en: : I think it was around 3 AM.
lines.zh: : 我想是凌晨三点左右。

lines.en: scene sunbathing13
: Wh-what?! What the hell were you two doing alone that late?
lines.zh: : 什……什么？！你们俩那么晚单独在一起搞什么？

lines.en: : Holy crap! Were you givin’ Sana that reverse cowboy thing from earlier?! Is that why she’s still passed out after noon?!
lines.zh: : 我靠！你是在给Sana用刚才那个反向牛仔吗？！所以她过了中午还昏着？！

lines.en: : Wait? She’s still asleep?
lines.zh: : 等等？她还在睡？

lines.en: : Heck yeah and it’s all your fault!
lines.zh: : 那可不，全是你的错！

lines.en: : Fuck you.
lines.zh: : 操你的。

lines.en: : Let me just clear up this misunderstanding now because that’s definitely not what happened.
lines.zh: : 我现在就把这个误会澄清一下，因为事情绝对不是那样。

lines.en: : I never had plans with Sana. I just woke up in the middle of the night and went for a walk.
lines.zh: : 我从来没和Sana约过。我只是半夜醒了，出去走走。

lines.en: : She happened to be sitting on the beach so the two of us just chatted about stuff for a while and then went back.
lines.zh: : 她正好坐在海滩上，所以我们俩就聊了一会儿，然后就回去了。

lines.en: scene sunbathing14
: So...nothing else happened after that?
lines.zh: : 所以……之后没发生别的？

lines.en: : Nothing else happened after that.
lines.zh: : 之后没发生别的。

lines.en: : Well then why the heck is she still asleep? Did somebody else give her the cowboy?
lines.zh: : 那她干嘛还在睡？难道别人给她用了「牛仔」？

lines.en: : I really hope not. I don’t know how I’d deal with that news.
lines.zh: : 我真希望不是。我不知道自己要怎么接受那种消息。

lines.en: : Something about your story seems a little fishy...but I won’t push any further.
lines.zh: : 你这故事总有点可疑……不过我不追问了。

lines.en: : Tell that to the guy who cowboyed Sana. He did plenty of pushing from what I gather.
lines.zh: : 这话你去跟对Sana用「牛仔」的那个人说啊。听我这么说，他也没少推。

lines.en: : Okay, Miku, please don't use 'cowboy' as a verb.
lines.zh: : 好了，Miku，别把「牛仔」当动词用。

lines.en: scene sunbathing15
: Joke’s on you! I don’t even remember what a verb is!
lines.zh: : 逗你玩的！我连动词是什么都不记得了！

lines.en: : Well, at the very least, don’t go around spreading rumors about Sana and me.
lines.zh: : 那么至少，别到处散播关于我和Sana的谣言。

lines.en: : Awfully suspicious thing for ya to say when ‘yer out there givin’ the quietest girl in class the-
lines.zh: : 你这话说得可真可疑，明明你还给班上最安静的女生用了——

lines.en: scene sunbathing16
: Say “cowboy” one more time and I’m cutting the straps off of your swimsuit!
lines.zh: : 你再说一次「牛仔」，我就把你泳衣的带子剪断！

lines.en: scene sunbathing17
: Ah! No! I’m flat as a board! It’ll fall right off!
lines.zh: : 啊！别！我平得像块板！它会直接掉下来的！

lines.en: : I don’t think this is one of those kind of beaches either!
lines.zh: : 而且我觉得这也不是那种海滩！

lines.en: : And if it is, all of us have been treatin’ this whole weekend very differently than we’re supposed to!
lines.zh: : 要是是的话，那我们所有人这个周末过得可跟该有的样子差远了！

lines.en: : Is talking with other girls normally this confusing?
lines.zh: : 跟其他女生说话都这么让人费解吗？

lines.en: : Talking with you is actually more confusing.
lines.zh: : 其实跟你说话更让人费解。

lines.en: : How? I only talk about noodles.
lines.zh: : 怎么会？我只聊面条啊。

lines.en: : Well...true. At least your conversations are easy to follow.
lines.zh: : 嗯……倒也是。至少你的对话内容很好懂。

lines.en: : But that doesn’t make them any less confusing thematically.
lines.zh: : 可这并不代表主题上就好懂。

lines.en: scene sunbathing18
: I just want to be a normal girl enjoying her youth.
lines.zh: : 我只是想当一个享受青春的普通女生。

lines.en: : But I’m afraid that ship has sailed now that I have learned the proper way to explore my body.
lines.zh: : 可既然我已经学会了探索自己身体的正确方式，恐怕那条船早就开走了。

lines.en: : I know you didn’t mean anything by that, but it sounded very seductive.
lines.zh: : 我知道你不是有意的，不过这话听着非常撩人。

lines.en: : I’m scared. What if I don’t like how it feels?
lines.zh: : 我好害怕。要是我感觉不喜欢呢？

lines.en: scene sunbathing19
: What the Hell are you making her talk about?!
lines.zh: : 你到底在让她聊什么啊？！

lines.en: : Okay, this time I really didn’t do anything. She just started saying all that by herself.
lines.zh: : 好好好，这次我真的什么都没做。这些都是她自己说出来的。

lines.en: : Likely story! You’re grounded!
lines.zh: : 说得好听！你被禁足了！

lines.en: : You can’t ground me...I’m over twice your age.
lines.zh: : 你不能禁我的足……我年纪比你大一倍还多。

lines.en: I think.
lines.zh: 大概吧。

lines.en: : Doesn’t matter.
lines.zh: : 无所谓。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo is pure and oblivious and it’s super cute and if you even think of corrupting her I swear on my love for idols that I will end you.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo又纯真又迟钝，可爱得要命，你要是敢动歪念头想带坏她，我以我对偶像的爱发誓，我会把你了结了。

lines.en: scene sunbathing20
: I’m afraid that I was already corrupted by Miku last night.
lines.zh: : 恐怕我昨晚已经被Miku带坏了。

lines.en: : It’s true. Got a pretty good feel, too. Nice and firm. Totally not jealous.
lines.zh: : 是真的。手感还挺好。又结实又弹。完全没有嫉妒。

lines.en: scene sunbathing21
: Thank you.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。

lines.en: : I think you have very nice legs.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你的腿很好看。

lines.en: : Thanks! I run a lot so they’re pretty muscley, but I think they’re nice too.
lines.zh: : 谢谢！我跑步很多，所以肌肉挺明显的，不过我也觉得很好看。

lines.en: What is it with Tsuneyo and legs? She said the same thing about Ami.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo怎么这么在意腿？她对Ami也说过一样的话。

lines.en: : Do you think I could touch them?
lines.zh: : 我可以摸摸吗？

lines.en: scene sunbathing22
: What, you mean like, as revenge for me accidentally copping a feel last night?
lines.zh: : 什么，你是说，为昨晚我不小心袭胸的事报仇？

lines.en: : No. I just want to touch them.
lines.zh: : 不。我只是想摸摸。

lines.en: scene sunbathing23
: Umm...it’s...kinda embarrassing when you put it that way. But I guess it’s fine.
lines.zh: : 嗯……你这么一说还挺难为情的。不过我想可以吧。

lines.en: : Thank you.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。

lines.en: : Please do not touch my boob again, though.
lines.zh: : 不过请别再碰我的胸了。

lines.en: : That area is reserved for the man I fall in love with.
lines.zh: : 那个地方是留给我爱上的人的。

lines.en: : You are very pretty, but I fear that we will never fall in love.
lines.zh: : 你很好看，但恐怕我们永远不会坠入爱河。

lines.en: scene sunbathing24
: I can’t tell if this is helpin’ my self-esteem or ruining it.
lines.zh: : 我不知道这到底是在帮我建立自信还是在毁掉它。

lines.en: : I’ve heard that it’s hard figuring out what I mean at times, so I understand.
lines.zh: : 我听说有时候很难理解我的意思，所以我明白。

lines.en: scene sunbathing25
: I’m guessing this isn’t really how you imagined your morning going, is it?
lines.zh: : 我猜你今早的展开跟你想象的完全不一样吧？

lines.en: : No, I’ve come to basically expect things like this every day. This is my life now.
lines.zh: : 不，我基本上已经习惯了每天都是这种事。这就是我现在的人生。

lines.en: : You doing anything afterward?
lines.zh: : 你之后有什么安排吗？

lines.en: : After this? Not anything I can think of. How about you?
lines.zh: : 这之后？想不出有什么。你呢？

lines.en: scene sunbathing26
: Rin and I were gonna hang out later. Think there was something she wanted to talk about.
lines.zh: : 我和Rin待会儿要一起玩。她好像有什么想跟我谈。

lines.en: : We had a little bit of a heart-to-heart last night. A lot different from how we were that one time at the cafe.
lines.zh: : 昨晚我们聊了会儿心里话。跟那次在咖啡馆的时候完全不一样。

lines.en: : I’m glad she’s been in a better mood lately. Seeing her get all weird was a hardcore bummer when I know how bright and cheerful she can be.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴她最近心情好了些。我知道她能有多阳光开朗，所以看她变得那么别扭，真的很丧。

lines.en: Huh...interesting.
lines.zh: 嗯……有意思。

lines.en: If there’s something Rin wanted to talk to Chika about...she couldn’t be thinking of confessing, could she?
lines.zh: 如果Rin有什么想跟Chika谈的……她该不会是在想告白吧？

lines.en: I feel like that’s something I would have known about beforehand.
lines.zh: 我觉得这种事我应该事先就会知道。

lines.en: I’ll have to talk to her sometime before the two of them meet up and see what’s going on.
lines.zh: 我得在她们俩见面之前找她谈谈，看看是怎么回事。

lines.en: : Well, that’s good. I’m glad you two are getting along well. You have weirdly good chemistry.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那很好。我很高兴你们俩相处得好。你们的化学反应好得出奇。

lines.en: scene sunbathing27
: I know, right?! Like, I’ve got plenty of friends, don’t get me wrong, but no one that’s like her.
lines.zh: : 我也觉得！别误会，我朋友挺多的，可没一个像她那样。

lines.en: : Everybody I hang out with is more into like, fashion and stuff like that. But Rin is super creative and I totally respect that kind of person.
lines.zh: : 我身边的人大多更关注时尚什么的。可Rin特别有创造力，我打心底尊敬那种人。

lines.en: : Did you know she plays guitar?
lines.zh: : 你知道她会弹吉他吗？

lines.en: : I did.
lines.zh: : 我知道。

lines.en: scene sunbathing28
: So cool, right?!
lines.zh: : 很酷吧？！

lines.en: : Do you think she’d teach me?
lines.zh: : 你觉得她愿意教我吗？

lines.en: : That’s...something you’d have to ask her about.
lines.zh: : 这……你得自己去问她。

lines.en: : Yeah, I figured. I know you two are close, so I just wasn’t sure if you’d know the answer off the top of your head or not.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我想也是。我知道你们俩关系很好，所以不确定你会不会随口就知道答案。

lines.en: scene sunbathing29
: Also, between you and me...I think she might have a crush on you.
lines.zh: : 还有，就我们俩说……我觉得她可能暗恋你。

lines.en: That’s not good.
lines.zh: 这可不妙。

lines.en: I’m not sure what Chika and Rin talked about last night, but I’m pretty sure that Rin’s true feelings didn’t come across if this is the impression Chika was left with.
lines.zh: 我不确定Chika和Rin昨晚聊了什么，不过如果Chika留下的是这种印象，那Rin真正的感情显然没有传达到。

lines.en: if chikadorm20 == True:
: What are you gonna say to her if that’s true?
lines.zh: : 如果是真的，你打算跟她怎么说？

lines.en: : Like...you and me are already a thing.
lines.zh: : 比如说……你和我已经在一起了。

lines.en: : And I love the girl but...I don’t really want to share you. And she doesn’t know about us either.
lines.zh: : 而且我爱那丫头，可是……我不太想跟别人分享你。而且她还不知道我们的事。

lines.en: : You know...maybe it’s best if we talk about this when there aren’t two other girls sitting right next to you.
lines.zh: : 你知道……这件事最好还是等旁边没坐着另外两个女生的时候再谈。

lines.en: : But I’m a really good whisperer. See? They haven’t even noticed.
lines.zh: : 可我特别擅长说悄悄话。看吧？她们根本没注意到。

lines.en: : I see that. But I’m a very bad whisperer and they would definitely notice if I tried saying something.
lines.zh: : 看出来了。可我非常不擅长说悄悄话，我要是开口，她们肯定会注意到。

lines.en: : Okay. We can talk later then.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那我们晚点再聊。

lines.en: : Works for me...
lines.zh: : 我没意见……

lines.en: else:
: What are you going to do if that’s true?
lines.zh: : 要是那是真的，你打算怎么办？

lines.en: : I haven’t really thought about it, to be honest...
lines.zh: : 说实话，我还真没想过……

lines.en: Well, correction- I have thought about it.
lines.zh: 嗯，更正一下——我想过。

lines.en: But Rin’s made it overwhelmingly apparent how interested in Chika she is.
lines.zh: 可是Rin对Chika有多上心，已经表现得再明显不过了。

lines.en: I mean, the girl is basically obsessed.
lines.zh: 我的意思是，那丫头基本上就是着了魔。

lines.en: So what I’m more concerned about than anything is how Chika will react if she finds out it’s her that Rin is into.
lines.zh: 所以比起别的，我更担心的是：要是Chika发现Rin喜欢的人就是她，她会怎么反应。

lines.en: Because right now...it seems like she doesn’t have any idea whatsoever.
lines.zh: 因为现在看来……她似乎一点头绪都没有。

lines.en: And that worries me.
lines.zh: 而那让我担心。

lines.en: So...maybe there’s a way for me to find out?
lines.zh: 所以……也许有什么办法能让我弄清楚？

lines.en: : If you were in my shoes, what would you do?
lines.zh: : 如果你处在我的立场，你会怎么办？

lines.en: : If I were in your shoes?
lines.zh: : 如果我处在你的立场？

lines.en: scene sunbathing30
: Hmm...
: Well...I obviously can’t get into your head so I don’t know how attracted you are to her...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我显然钻不进你的脑子，所以不知道你对她有多着迷……

lines.en: : But I would consider that there are probably several other girls into you as well...And some might be a little more suited to your tastes or-
lines.zh: : 但我会考虑到，喜欢你的女生大概还有好几个……而有些可能更符合你的口味，或者——

lines.en: scene sunbathing31
: More mature...
lines.zh: : 更成熟一点……

lines.en: scene sunbathing32
: Not to say she’s not or anything! It’s just...you know.
lines.zh: : 不是说她不成熟什么的！只是……你知道的。

lines.en: scene sunbathing33
: Hey, what are you guys whisperin’ about over there?
lines.zh: : 嘿，你们两个在那儿嘀咕什么呢？

lines.en: : Huh?! Oh! Uhh...nothing! We were just talking about our plans for tonight and stuff...
lines.zh: : 哈？！哦！呃……没什么！我们只是在聊今晚的安排什么的……

lines.en: : Well then why the heck were you whispering? You guys up to some secret, no-good stuff?
lines.zh: : 那你干嘛要嘀咕？你们两个在搞什么见不得人的事吗？

lines.en: : We’re not up to anything!
lines.zh: : 我们什么都没搞！

lines.en: : You’re up to something.
lines.zh: : 你们在搞事。

lines.en: : You too, Tsuneyo?!
lines.zh: : 连你也是吗，Tsuneyo？！

lines.en: scene sunbathing34
: Ah-
scene black
The conversation quickly spirals into a series of other spontaneous topics like where we’d want our next vacation to be or what the girls plan on dressing up as for Halloween.
lines.zh: 话题很快转到了一连串突发的话题上，比如下次想去哪儿度假，或者女生们万圣节打算扮什么。

lines.en: Apparently, Tsuneyo had never heard of Halloween, so we needed to explain that to her...which took around half an hour or so.
lines.zh: 据说Tsuneyo从来没听说过万圣节，所以我们还得给她解释……这花了大概半个小时。

lines.en: Actually, I’m pretty sure it took even longer.
lines.zh: 其实，我敢肯定花的时间还要更长。

lines.en: I wound up leaving before the discussion ended and started heading back to the inn to take a break from everything...
lines.zh: 最后我在讨论结束前就走了，动身回旅馆，想从这一切里喘口气……
